writeup: Woot has the VersaInk-Nano 65 MS MICR black ink cartridge new for $16.41. It is bank-compliant magnetic ink for printing your own checks on HP DeskJet 2655 and 3755 printers, rated for about 500 pages. VersaCheck's own store charges $79.99 and RetailMarket $75.49 for the same cartridge, with a limit of 10 per customer.
